question: at which level does the branching that keeps the triple unique live, and is the role already separated there?
method: exact counts over the persisted R04 hard SID joined with the frozen role table; the fourth column is the export collision counter
reading: Level 1 already uses all 256 codes (7.47 of 8 bits), so there is nothing left to coarsen there. The explosion is at level 2: 8781 prefixes over 256 first codes is 34 second codes per first code, while the median prefix holds a single item. Within a prefix the roles are already almost pure (median 1 role) and the level-3 refinement adds only 1.57 distinct third codes per (prefix, role) cell. The remaining freedom therefore sits in how many distinct second codes a level-1 cell opens, not in the level-1 or level-3 mixture.
next_direction: R05 moves the role-conditioned curvature mixture to the level-2 cost (the third and last placement): same-role items must share second codes across the level-1 cell, which is the measured lever (34 second codes per first code, median 1 item per prefix).
